name: Obsidian
description: Obsidian is a private, local-first note-taking and knowledge-management app built around Markdown files. People use linked notes, properties, search, graph views, canvases, and plugins to develop a durable personal or team knowledge base.
agentUseSummary: Bind one exact local vault and source host, then let selected agents search, read, create, or append bounded Markdown notes through Obsidian's official CLI under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions. Railway persists the connection and install policy, but note plaintext executes only on the bound device authority.

credentialRequirements.name: OBSIDIAN_SOURCE_HOST_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Source host
credentialRequirements.helpText: A connected Hermes or OpenClaw source host with Obsidian 1.12.7+ and the official CLI enabled.

credentialRequirements.name: OBSIDIAN_SOURCE_HOST_TYPE
credentialRequirements.label: Source host type
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact hermes_bridge, openclaw_bridge, or runtime_host authority.

credentialRequirements.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT
credentialRequirements.label: Vault name or ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact local vault name or ID; Relay never receives its filesystem path.

capabilities.label: Read local vault
capabilities.description: Search up to twenty note paths and read one exact Markdown note with a 64 KiB response bound.

capabilities.label: Write local vault
capabilities.description: Create one non-overwriting Markdown note or append at most 16 KiB to one exact existing note.

approvalRequired.label: Search notes
approvalRequired.description: Search at most twenty matching note paths in the selected vault.

approvalRequired.label: Read note
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact bounded Markdown note.

approvalRequired.label: Create note
approvalRequired.description: Create one exact Markdown note without overwriting an existing file.

approvalRequired.label: Append to note
approvalRequired.description: Append bounded Markdown to one exact existing note.

blocked.label: Run raw command
blocked.description: Raw CLI commands, command-palette IDs, eval, developer tools, plugin management, sync, publish, workspace control, deletes, moves, renames, and filesystem paths are outside Relay's V1 surface.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Private note reads and every mutation require approval. Exact source-host and vault binding, path validation, content and output bounds, and audits always apply.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All four selected Obsidian actions run without Relay per-action approval; exact source-host and vault binding, path validation, content and output bounds, and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway registers bounded tools and forwards execution only to the exact connected OpenClaw source host; note plaintext remains device-local.
Railway registers bounded tools and forwards execution only to the exact connected Hermes source host; note plaintext remains device-local.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer installs Obsidian 1.12.7 or later, enables Command line interface in Settings > General, connects a source host, and selects one exact vault.

evidence.supports: Obsidian's official CLI requires the 1.12 installer and an enabled CLI, targets an exact vault by name or ID, and documents bounded search, exact-path read, non-overwriting create, and append commands.
Obsidian documents a vault as a folder hierarchy and distinguishes safe cached reads from modification APIs, supporting Relay's exact vault and note-path boundary.
